name: Application Programming Interface
definition: A defined way for software components to request data or functionality from one another.

name: Artificial Intelligence
definition: Computing methods for tasks such as learning, reasoning, and recognizing patterns.

name: Continuous Integration
definition: A practice of frequently combining code changes and checking them with automated builds and tests.

name: Database
definition: An organized collection of data that can be stored, retrieved, and updated.

name: Domain Name System
definition: A distributed naming system that maps domain names to records such as IP addresses.

name: Hypertext Transfer Protocol
definition: An application protocol for exchanging requests and responses between clients and servers.

name: JavaScript
definition: A programming language commonly used for interactive web pages and server applications.

name: Machine Learning
definition: Methods that learn patterns from data to make predictions or decisions.

name: Structured Query Language
definition: A language for defining, querying, and modifying data in relational databases.

name: Version Control
definition: A system for tracking changes to files and coordinating work across revisions.
